sections.Profile:
The Aquarius pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1970, features an astrology theme and was designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Astrology, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Art Stenholm
